name: 约翰·罗纳德·瑞尔·托尔金

points.title: 童年起点
points.description: 1892年1月3日，托尔金出生于南非布隆方丹，父亲是英国银行亚瑟·托尔金。然而，在他3岁时，父亲因风湿热去世，母亲决定带他返回英格兰。这段短暂的非洲经历对他影响深远，后来他在作品中多次提及对南非的怀念与对父亲的思念，这些情感成为他创作中复杂情感体验的源头。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Bloemfontein, South Africa, to Arthur Tolkien, a bank manager, Tolkien spent only his first three years in Africa. His father died of rheumatic fever in 1894, and his mother Mabel decided to return to England with her children. This brief African experience profoundly influenced Tolkien, who later referenced his memories of South Africa and longing for his father in his works, contributing to the complex emotional depth in his writing.

points.title: 学术奠基
points.description: 托尔金进入牛津大学埃克塞特学院学习古典文学、英语语言和文学。在这里，他接触到了北欧神话、凯尔特传说和早期英语文学，这些成为他后来创作的重要灵感来源。1914年，他遇到了未来的妻子伊迪丝·布拉特，两人相爱并私奔。第一次世界大战爆发后，他于1915年毕业，随即参军，在西线战场服役，这段经历深刻影响了他对战争、友谊和牺牲的理解。
points.descriptionEn: Tolkien attended Exeter College, Oxford, where he studied Classics, English Language and Literature. At Oxford, he was exposed to Norse mythology, Celtic legends, and early English literature, which became major inspirations for his later works. In 1914, he met Edith Bratt, his future wife, and they eloped against the wishes of his guardian. With the outbreak of World War I, he graduated in 1915 and was commissioned as a second lieutenant in the British Army, serving on the Western Front. This experience profoundly influenced his understanding of war, friendship, and sacrifice.

points.title: 语言学教授
points.description: 1925年，托尔金回到牛津大学担任盎格鲁-撒克逊语教授，后于1926年转任英语语言与文学教授。这一时期，他不仅是一位杰出的语言学家，还开始构建自己的神话世界。他在牛津的学术圈中与C.S.刘易斯等人成为好友，共同组成'墨水会'。正是在这个时期，他开始创作《霍比特人》，并于1937年出版。第二次世界大战期间，他的儿子们参战，这促使他更加专注于《魔戒》的创作，这部作品在战后完成并出版。
points.descriptionEn: Returning to Oxford in 1925, Tolkien became Professor of Anglo-Saxon at Pembroke College, later moving to the Merton Professorship of English Language and Literature in 1926. During this period, he not only excelled as a philologist but began constructing his own mythical world. He formed a close friendship with C.S. Lewis and other writers in the 'Inklings' group. It was during this time that he began writing 'The Hobbit,' published in 1937. During World War II, with his sons serving in the military, he focused intensely on writing 'The Lord of the Rings,' completed and published after the war.

points.title: 巅峰创作
points.description: 1945年，托尔金被任命为牛津大学英语语言与文学教授，这是他学术生涯的巅峰。在此期间，他完成了《魔戒》三部曲的写作，这部作品历时十余年，融合了他对语言学、神话学、哲学和宗教的深刻理解。1954-1955年，《魔戒》三部曲陆续出版，立即获得巨大成功。同时，他继续完善自己的神话体系，包括《精灵宝钻》等作品的创作。这一时期，他的作品开始影响一代作家和读者，奠定了现代奇幻文学的基础。
points.descriptionEn: Appointed Professor of English Language and Literature at Oxford in 1945, Tolkien reached the pinnacle of his academic career. During this period, he completed 'The Lord of the Rings,' a work over a decade in the making that reflected his deep understanding of linguistics, mythology, philosophy, and religion. Published in three volumes between 1954-1955, the trilogy was an immediate success. He continued developing his mythological framework, including works like 'The Silmarillion.' This period saw his works begin to influence generations of writers and readers, establishing the foundation of modern fantasy literature.

points.title: 晚年岁月
points.description: 1959年，托尔金从牛津大学退休，与妻子伊迪丝搬到伯恩居住。退休后，他继续整理和创作自己的神话作品，但健康状况逐渐恶化。1971年，伊迪丝去世，这对托尔金是沉重打击。1973年9月2日，托尔金在伯恩逝世，享年81岁。他生前未能看到《精灵宝钻》出版，这部作品由其儿子克里斯托弗整理后于1977年出版。托尔金的去世标志着一个文学时代的结束，但他的作品继续影响全球文化，被翻译成多种语言，改编成电影、游戏等多种形式，成为20世纪最具影响力的文学作品之一。
points.descriptionEn: Retiring from Oxford in 1959, Tolkien moved with his wife Edith to Bournemouth. After retirement, he continued working on his mythological works, but his health gradually declined. Edith's death in 1971 was a profound blow to Tolkien. He passed away on September 2, 1973, at the age of 81. He did not live to see the publication of 'The Silmarillion,' which was edited and published by his son Christopher in 1977. Tolkien's death marked the end of an literary era, but his works continued to influence global culture, translated into numerous languages and adapted into films, games, and other forms, becoming one of the most influential literary works of the 20th century.

supporter.zh: 托尔金被誉为现代奇幻文学之父，他的作品不仅创造了完整而复杂的神话世界，更深刻影响了整个奇幻文学类型。支持者认为，托尔金通过《魔戒》等作品探讨了友谊、勇气、牺牲等永恒主题，创造了具有普遍人性意义的文学经典。他对语言学的精通使他创造了多种精灵语言，赋予其作品无与伦比的深度和真实感。托尔金的遗产不仅在于文学成就，更在于他证明了神话和幻想可以承载深刻的哲学和道德思考。
supporter.en: Tolkien is hailed as the father of modern fantasy literature. His supporters argue that through works like 'The Lord of the Rings,' he explored timeless themes of friendship, courage, and sacrifice, creating literary classics with universal human significance. His mastery of linguistics enabled him to create multiple Elvish languages, giving his works unparalleled depth and authenticity. Tolkien's legacy extends beyond his literary achievements to demonstrating how mythology and fantasy can carry profound philosophical and moral reflections.

critic.zh: 批评者指出托尔金的作品存在明显的局限性，包括过于男性中心的视角、种族主义倾向（如对角色的种族刻画），以及叙事节奏缓慢等问题。一些评论家认为他的神话构建过于复杂，难以吸引普通读者。此外，托尔金对工业化的批判和对田园生活的理想化被批评为怀旧和逃避现实。他的作品也被指责缺乏强烈的女性角色，反映了当时社会的性别偏见。这些批评者认为，尽管托尔金的文学成就不可否认，但他的作品需要放在特定的历史和文化背景中理解。
critic.en: Critics point out several limitations in Tolkien's work, including its male-centric perspective, racial undertones in character portrayals, and slow narrative pace. Some argue his mythological constructions are overly complex and inaccessible to general readers. Additionally, Tolkien's critique of industrialization and idealization of rural life have been criticized as nostalgic and escapist. His works have also been noted for lacking strong female characters, reflecting the gender biases of his time. These critics acknowledge Tolkien's literary achievements but argue his works must be understood within their specific historical and cultural context.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，托尔金已被符号化为一个文化现象，超越了单纯的文学范畴。他的作品不仅重新定义了奇幻文学类型，还影响了整个流行文化，从音乐到游戏，从电影到时尚。托尔金创造的 Middle-earth 已成为集体想象的一部分，他的角色和故事被不断重新诠释和改编。学术界对他的研究已形成专门的'托尔金学'，探讨其作品的语言学、文学和哲学价值。在当代文化中，托尔金既被视为文学大师，也被视为文化偶像，他的影响力持续扩大，证明了伟大文学作品的持久生命力。
objective.en: From historical and popular culture perspectives, Tolkien has been symbolized as a cultural phenomenon that transcends mere literature. His works not only redefined the fantasy genre but influenced entire aspects of popular culture, from music and gaming to film and fashion. Middle-earth, as created by Tolkien, has become part of collective imagination, with his characters and stories continuously reinterpreted and adapted. Academia has developed 'Tolkien studies' as a specialized field examining the linguistic, literary, and philosophical value of his works. In contemporary culture, Tolkien is viewed both as a literary master and a cultural icon, with his influence continuing to expand, demonstrating the enduring vitality of great literary works.

self.zh: 我不写'关于'童话的故事；我写的是童话故事。
self.en: I do not write 'about' fairy stories; I write fairy stories.

others.zh: 托尔金创造了一个世界，并赋予它一种语言，从而使其成为真实。这是所有伟大作家所做的，但很少有人能做到如此彻底。
others.en: Tolkien created a world and gave it a language, thereby making it real. This is what all great writers do, but few have done it so completely.
